steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
List. Each input, decision and action is stacked for the annual review.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Required input missing
findings.fix: Add the input before the review

outcome.notChecked: Whether the decisions were carried out.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 2 medium).
[high] input-audit.md:12  Required input missing.
       Fix: Add the input before the review.
[medium] decisions.md:19  Decision with no reason.
       Fix: Record the reason.
[medium] actions.md:26  Action with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
Not checked: Whether the decisions were carried out.
pros: Checks a missing required input, a decision with no reason, and an action with no owner.
cons: Not checked: Whether the decisions were carried out.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-qual-management-review skill on the records for this review.
